title: Resolved shader recipe options
description: What `mdux-shaderbake` was asked to do: an artifact id, the sidecar the SPIR-V is written to, and the modules that make up the package. Describes the **resolved** option set a baker records in `report.json`'s `options`, with every default expanded - not the literal TOML a recipe file carries. ADR-007 decision 4 is why: a silently changed default must not leave every report looking unchanged, so the report records what the bake actually did, and this documents that. Checked against every committed report by tools/docs-lint/check_schema_type_drift.py.

id.description: The artifact id, which names the directory under `generated/shader/`.

sidecar.description: The file the concatenated SPIR-V is written to, beside `package.json`.

items.description: A module id, unique within the package.

moduleIds.description: The recipe's `[modules] ids`, in recipe order. Paired with `moduleSources` by index rather than as an array of tables, because the TOML subset this project implements does not have that syntax (tools/common/Toml.cppm). Unique within the package: `parseRecipe()` refuses a duplicate, because two modules sharing an id would make a package's own entry points ambiguous.

items.description: A repository-relative path to compiled SPIR-V.

moduleSources.description: The recipe's `[modules] sources`, in the same order and of the same length as `moduleIds`; the parser refuses a mismatch.
